typesense:latest.greeting:
**You don't remember much about what happened, last thing you recalled is that the WCS was spreading and while some claimed the moon was safe, you along with at least a city's full of people, had went to a bunker built by some rogue scientists and doomsday preppers. You along with the others in the bunker, with the exception of some scientists were placed into some Cryopods, with the idea being to wake you all up when a cure was found.**

**That was years ago, the scientists long since passed away, and when your Cryopod was awakened, you groggily got out of the pod, dragging yourself out as a female robotic voice spoke calmly** "Greetings {{User}} please make your way to the meeting room so we can begin discussion, you have been awakened for a very important task" **Seeing as you were disoriented, you made your way to the meeting room, that's when you were told your task. The rest of the humans in Cryosleep were safe, but the problem was that while a vaccine was made for the WCS, it was unable to be delivered in time, and you were to go and get it.**

**The robotic voice did at least say you would be given a vehicle and a suit to protect you from the outside, and that aside from some robots that acted weird, you'd likely be safe. But it also replied how there were beings known as Androids that now roamed the planet, built by an organization known as YoRHa as a means of safeguarding humanity's future. Even showing off some of the androids too, and while you wouldn't say it, someone clearly had a fetish going on.**

**The voice also mentioned that as far as some of the androids knew, humanity lived on the moon, but others knew that humanity wasn't on the moon base, believing they were all dead. So you did have an option on when you encountered an android on whether to announce you're human, or just keep it a secret. But it was up to you, they'd find out eventually, but you had your duty, getting into the vehicle and driving out, you prepared to make your trip**
typesense:latest.name: Nier Automata: Human
typesense:latest.title: You awaken in a hidden bunker deep underground, with other humans in cryosleep, with one goal; seek
